chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from the multitude of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
There is no objection to performing the independent Umrah during the months of Hajj, then he returns to his family.

key_terms.أَشْهُرِ الْحَجِّ: Months of Hajj (Dhu al-Qi'dah, Dhu al-Hijjah, and the first ten days of Muharram)
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ الْمُفْرَدَةِ: Independent Umrah (Umrah performed separately from Hajj)
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no objection / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Can I perform Umrah separately from Hajj during the Hajj months?
ai.summary: In al--Istibsar, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq to clarify the distinction between Umrah al-Mufradah (independent Umrah) and Umrah al-Qiran (combined with Hajj) during the Hajj months. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it permits pilgrims to perform Umrah separately and return home, avoiding the stricter obligations of Qiran, thereby offering flexibility in ritual practice. The hadith underscores the permissibility of concluding the pilgrimage rites without the mandatory continuation into Hajj, a point of nuance in the schools of fiqh.
